instruction: I want to rename my Chrome profile to 'Elizabeth'. Please update the profile name to Elizabeth.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name from default to 'Elizabeth'. Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric to verify the profile name was updated correctly. Same difficulty level as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts profile name from Chrome Preferences file at the right JSON path (profile.name)
Metric performs appropriate exact string comparison for profile name verification
Expected value 'Elizabeth' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is saved and refreshed
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement (profile name change to 'Elizabeth')
Runtime feasible: getter can access standard Chrome Preferences location, metric can compare strings
